question: What functions as initiation when divine fitness is present?
premises: In that case, knowledge itself is initiation.
This is stated in the teaching of the revered Traishika.
As a result, sudden knowledge of the meaning of all scriptures arises in him.
inference: When divine fitness is present, knowledge alone serves as initiation and produces immediate mastery of scriptural meaning.
uncertainties: The exact Traishika passage is not identified in this verse.
plain_english: Then knowledge alone is initiation, as taught in the revered Traishika; and from it he suddenly gains the ability to know the meaning of all scriptures.
